query:
The group settled on a Peckham birthday night for Zara. What did one member's response to that plan reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Priya
C. Dom
D. Kezia
context:
[1] (about=Dom, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:20:00) Yeah yeah I know. Not happy about it but I know. Anyway, let's talk about something else before I depress myself completely. Zara isn't your birthday coming up?
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:21:00) okay so YES October 4th and I have been trying not to make a big deal of it but actually I would love to do something with all of you 🥳 like dinner and then out in Peckham? There's that bar near the Bussey Building that opened this summer 🍹🎶
[3] (about=Felix, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:24:00) October 4th. I will make it work. A birthday is a reasonable occasion to venture to Peckham on a Saturday night.
[4] (about=GROUP, said_by=Kezia, group-interaction, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Kezia enthusiastically agrees to Ethiopian, says injera and shared plates are perfect birthday vibe.
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t14 @2025-10-20T19:05:30) Group Christmas dinner planned: first Saturday of December at Zara's? Marcus will cook.
[6] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:08:00) The birthday in October was better than I expected.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Zara, group-interaction, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Zara's birthday celebration decided: dinner in Peckham then a bar, all of us, October 4th.
agent_answer:
C. Dom.

Dom’s response revealed that he was privately unhappy about the Peckham plan, even though he outwardly acknowledged it. The tell is his own words: **“Not happy about it but I know”** — he explicitly states displeasure while conceding the decision — and his attempt to change the subject **“before I depress myself completely,”** showing the plan genuinely bothered him.
